title: President Lincoln's Cottage

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Ideal for both intimate and larger events, this beautiful, historic home will inspire your guests. Our different spaces can easily accommodate intimate dinners and corporate meetings, as well as large receptions, staff appreciation field days, and more. Built in 1842 by George Washington Riggs, this 34-room Gothic Revival-style mansion will give your guests something to talk about for years to come. Abraham Lincoln, who lived at the cottage at the Soldiers’ Home for a quarter of his presidency, welcomed friends, political adversaries and dignitaries in these rooms.
